what: On first open, while the page is being received, a figure standing in the middle of the background-color curtain (the original is a single stroke of an office chair) is drawn very slowly over 130s (stroke-dashoffset, cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)) — it only shows that loading hasn’t stopped. Once everything is received (window load + fonts, or fx:ready), it starts drawing the remaining line right there over 5s cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955). 1.5s later the figure fades over 1s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), and .4s after that the curtain is removed at once and fx:done fires. Vanishing before it is fully drawn is exactly as in the original

options.[data-fx-part=line]: Stroke SVG (draws every path, line and circle inside) or a single path. Size is --fx-line-w (default 6.2vw, min 48px), stroke width --fx-stroke (.58)
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: (If present) group that fades — if absent, the line fades
options.finish · finish-ease: Length drawn out after everything is received, 5s · 0.455,0.03,0.515,0.955
options.hold: Time from the start of the closing stroke to the fade-out (sec), default 1.5
options.gap: Seconds from blur start until it is cleared/fx:done, default .4
options.ready: If event, it does not wait for window load and counts everything as received when fx:ready arrives (an app that sends it after loading its own photos)
options.skip: sessionStorage key — if the value (handoff time, Date.now() ms) is within 4 seconds, fx:done fires right away without the curtain (the sender sets it when an inner link is clicked. The original has no curtain for in-app navigation). A stale value means an interrupted handoff, so the curtain is shown
options.--fx-veil / --fx-ink: Curtain background and line color, default --kf-bg / --kf-ink

note: The cover is laid over the page from the first paint by CSS (position: fixed, z-index 100). With reduced motion, CSS removes the cover and fires fx:done on the next frame. fx:done bubbles up like a bubble, so the document can catch it too, as with wait: fx:done in ring-spin-photos.

from.where: shared.js·index.html .vf-loader (original IntroLoadingAssets — a single office-chair stroke, 6.2vw wide, line .58, centered on a white curtain. It crawls over 130s until all product photos are loaded, then finishes drawing in 5s and fades out 1.5s later. The drawing is a chair we newly drew)
